title.justification: This is the title of the paper
title.quote:
IG-RL: Inductive Graph Reinforcement Learning
for Massive-Scale Traffic Signal Control

extractions.description: The paper introduces Inductive Graph Reinforcement Learning (IG-RL) based on graph-convolutional networks for adaptive traffic signal control. The model adapts to the structure of any road network and can generalize to new road networks and traffic distributions with no additional training.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving traffic flow using AI which reduces congestion, a key factor impacting the social and environmental costs in urban areas.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote:
The steady growth of the world’s population, combined
with a lack of space in urban areas, leads to intractable
road congestion, the social and environmental costs of which
are well documented [1].

primary_category.justification: The paper aims to reduce traffic congestion which leads to decreased Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions.
primary_category.quote:
We introduce Inductive Graph Reinforcement Learning (IG-RL), which combines the inductive capabilities of graph-convolutional networks (GCNs) [16] with a new decentralized
RL (DEC-RL) framework. In our independent Q-Learning
(IQL) formulation, multi-agent RL is replaced by a shared
policy, learned and applied in a decentralized fashion.

primary_sub_category.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on optimizing traffic flow and signal control, which directly falls under the transportation sub-category.
